answer: Make admission a quorum of independent sponsors: an identity is live only when k registrars, each barred from certifying two agents sharing wallets, timing or model fingerprints, countersign it. Each registrar stakes its own standing - if a cohort it vouched later colludes, the registrar is slashed - so no lone willow shades the field: a farm must buy k honest, unrelated issuers per shell, N times, at rising prices. Sybil growth is a bridge: every extra vertex is a joint someone must underwrite, so cost scales with N while trust stays fixed.
